symptom: The public page for vacation-2566 no longer shows a visible titled sleeping section with the detailed information for each bedroom, although the supplier record contains that detail.
expected_behavior: A vacation place with verified room-space data should visibly present a clear sleeping section and the detailed information for every bedroom without requiring visitors to discover a hidden secondary control.
environment: Public production page https://vii.spaplus.co/business?id=vacation-2566 on 2026-10-21, served from the AWS Aurora data origin and compared with the current release worktree history.

steps: Open the public vacation-2566 business page without dates.
Inspect the visible page text and the serialized initialProperty and supplierDetail payloads.
Compare the current room renderer with the earlier room presentation in git history.
reproduction.evidence: The rendered page contains the navigation label 'מבנה המקום' and a compact room card with 'פרטי היחידה', but contains neither 'איפה ישנים' nor a visible list of חדר שינה 1 through חדר שינה 5.

observations.observation: The detailed bedroom data is still delivered to the browser.
observations.evidence: The production RSC payload for vacation-2566 includes supplierDetail.rooms[0].featureGroups with titles חדר שינה 1 through חדר שינה 5 and their amenity items.

observations.observation: The public summary record lacks a top-level bedrooms field.
observations.evidence: The production initialProperty payload for vacation-2566 includes units and guests but no bedrooms or sleepingArrangements, while supplierDetail.rooms[0].bedrooms equals 5.

observations.observation: The current single-property renderer deliberately omits the room-section heading and keeps full groups in a dialog.
observations.evidence: app/business/client-page.tsx renders units-heading only when property.scenario is multi and renders featureGroups only through UnitDetailsDialog after clicking 'פרטי היחידה'.

observations.observation: The visible room presentation was compacted in an earlier release change.
observations.evidence: Git commit 0a99eef43d428b43a869f40dc7bd288fb3f0fb17 removed the single-property heading and inline room features and sleeping block, replacing them with the compact facts row and a details control.

hypotheses.mechanism: The supplier or Aurora data lost the bedroom information.
hypotheses.prediction: The production payload would contain no per-bedroom titles, counts, or amenity groups.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Inspect the serialized supplierDetail payload returned by the exact public page.
hypotheses.result: Rejected: the payload contains five named bedroom feature groups and five bedrooms in the supplier room record.

hypotheses.mechanism: A presentation regression hides existing room data and the explicit sleeping section depends on a missing top-level bedrooms field.
hypotheses.prediction: Detailed groups would exist in the payload but be absent from visible page text, while source conditions suppress the heading and sleeping section.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Compare visible production text, serialized data, renderer conditions, and the commit that changed the room-card layout.
hypotheses.result: Supported: all detailed groups are present, only the compact card is visible, single places receive no units heading, and the sleeping section condition fails because property.bedrooms is undefined.

fix.change: Not implemented in this diagnostic-only turn. Restore a visible 'איפה תישנו' presentation from room featureGroups, derive the bedroom count from supplier rooms, and keep the modal as an optional deeper view rather than the only access path.
fix.evidence: A fix must be proven on vacation-2566 and representative single-unit and multi-unit vacation pages before publication.

affected_family: All supplier-backed vacation business pages with room featureGroups
Single-property vacation pages whose summaries omit a top-level bedrooms field
Multi-unit vacation pages that expose detailed room groups only through the unit dialog
Desktop and mobile room-detail navigation, headings, cards, and galleries
remaining_unknowns: The intended final visual precedent for the restored section must be selected from the previously approved room or sleeping layouts before implementation.
authorization_boundary: Read-only diagnosis of production and repository history; no code change, database write, deployment, or publication was authorized in this turn.
